Plus a recap of the weekend...
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-r/) Dear Peter, I'll be debating Jared Polis again tonight in Colorado Springs, hosted by The Gazette, El Pomar, and KOAA! **While seating is all accounted for, you can tune in on Channel 5 or via the live stream on the link below.** [**Watch tonight's debate online HERE!**](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-y/) [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-j/) We had an awesome weekend on the campaign trail. After the debate Thursday night ([watch the replay here](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-t/)), we headed up to Yuma for a candidate forum, then to CCU for an event on failed drug policies, and finally spent our evening with the amazing people of The Colorado African Community. On Saturday, we headed back up to Northern Colorado for a great door-knocking event in Weld County, followed by an incredible Ride for Officer Dillon Vakoff who lost his life in the line of duty a month or so ago. To see the law enforcement and biker communities rally around the Vakoff family warmed my heart. We closed out the night with a fantastic rally in El Paso County! **Stay up to date on all our events and whereabouts at[heidiforgov.com/events](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-i/). ** Thank you for everything you're doing to spread our message and get out the vote!Heidi [$10](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-d/) [$50](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-h/) [$100](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-k/) [Other](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-u/) [Volunteer](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qtjiuhy-ttjjilthht-n/) Never miss a beat, follow me on social media! | | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=182b6c8fd88f45fdb5ae78dee00bd06a&_e=EoMZZDf_A_jVI0NPrXUWHIiFu2kFb4aUzR3tytZvi7i7EfQFxqvn7Ify2DsMDayRyUcKqKQ5wYmX1WKvM2dQAskGhUiJThO93r4uBwcHE4pQcDOW52Ws7Ae1B56eO9ZvJMkKBHS8wkgHCjLB4PwPDEQlkuaNKnDPhk-ARnm8eqInFPeiexCRiPgkZooLEsH2sKK_yraFPwLvQus6Xm46JdirMD7SQTcc7-N3LG3pJDrMsgFFywXU_wTpuiq_gMbc6eK3cTwDVDWDET6_7UBDiUF_o8XJ7vx0MPwEN3QprLyCeYYdTqia43K8EYbv7_6lh1RyziwcjN9BSDdd-fM8Mv91VzbCWAN8xKzeH06cy-xkvVQzo1pAcKDB3t37mvfzO4Ofmrt5o6DHrY7Slle1N08jvN-1MAriZa2nglYcWEbhu434vszmHdmJPPf0KdQz "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=182b6c8fd88f45fdb5ae78dee00bd06a&_e=EoMZZDf_A_jVI0NPrXUWHIiFu2kFb4aUzR3tytZvi7i7EfQFxqvn7Ify2DsMDayRyUcKqKQ5wYmX1WKvM2dQAskGhUiJThO93r4uBwcHE4pQcDOW52Ws7Ae1B56eO9ZvJMkKBHS8wkgHCjLB4PwPDEQlkuaNKnDPhk-ARnm8eqInFPeiexCRiPgkZooLEsH2sKK_yraFPwLvQus6Xm46JdirMD7SQTcc7-N3LG3pJDrMsgFFywXU_wTpuiq_gMbc6eK3cTwDVDWDET6_7UBDiUF_o8XJ7vx0MPwEN3QprLw-gNddyUGTeX_Uhuf5fVYaq2FGb-cdaO5xC78xL_F-HiZ90JUrIYkOKanD043Ss28wxPT126w32RxzLzLdxKlpiMszkB1UES8rOXL4ujcCXRbW5btMDmt4crI2JUQ5kGh6VVvTWVCwgL8_XwEl183j "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=182b6c8fd88f45fdb5ae78dee00bd06a&_e=EoMZZDf_A_jVI0NPrXUWHIiFu2kFb4aUzR3tytZvi7i7EfQFxqvn7Ify2DsMDayRyUcKqKQ5wYmX1WKvM2dQAskGhUiJThO93r4uBwcHE4pQcDOW52Ws7Ae1B56eO9ZvJMkKBHS8wkgHCjLB4PwPDEQlkuaNKnDPhk-ARnm8eqInFPeiexCRiPgkZooLEsH2sKK_yraFPwLvQus6Xm46JdirMD7SQTcc7-N3LG3pJDrMsgFFywXU_wTpuiq_gMbc6eK3cTwDVDWDET6_7UBDiUF_o8XJ7vx0MPwEN3QprLyE18tpsWgfdwB3XYQ1l4t5CnkZAIcjDQqvM8wKT4tRONcex_ghmemttUJ5W9Va1O-xouOQrsHAvTXGnaSHWk8PRzErLpAGTQp6XCsiZjsTQ2or2zpAG5uoZYgVkvudB0oUk92_7Yte9ZIqVx90o-UR "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=182b6c8fd88f45fdb5ae78dee00bd06a&_e=EoMZZDf_A_jVI0NPrXUWHIiFu2kFb4aUzR3tytZvi7i7EfQFxqvn7Ify2DsMDayRyUcKqKQ5wYmX1WKvM2dQAskGhUiJThO93r4uBwcHE4pQcDOW52Ws7Ae1B56eO9ZvJMkKBHS8wkgHCjLB4PwPDEQlkuaNKnDPhk-ARnm8eqInFPeiexCRiPgkZooLEsH2sKK_yraFPwLvQus6Xm46JdirMD7SQTcc7-N3LG3pJDrMsgFFywXU_wTpuiq_gMbc6eK3cTwDVDWDET6_7UBDiUF_o8XJ7vx0MPwEN3QprLyzqizNjOlPOH41wxcmywgBuyqHDvSqXFB12lOcYMTo-FBD7E9nssgGw959eSKYTs0zkWIhEZnxoylIs7xDAOsiJzg7SN9yp20kLQh2LziuPh_hP9q32W7axXnFLFtEO6CZspYnotxQZd05OdVsgq7S "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused.**_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=182b6c8fd88f45fdb5ae78dee00bd06a&_e=EoMZZDf_A_jVI0NPrXUWHIiFu2kFb4aUzR3tytZvi7i7EfQFxqvn7Ify2DsMDayRyUcKqKQ5wYmX1WKvM2dQAskGhUiJThO93r4uBwcHE4pQcDOW52Ws7Ae1B56eO9ZvJMkKBHS8wkgHCjLB4PwPDEQlkuaNKnDPhk-ARnm8eqInFPeiexCRiPgkZooLEsH2sKK_yraFPwLvQus6Xm46JdirMD7SQTcc7-N3LG3pJDrMsgFFywXU_wTpuiq_gMbc6eK3cTwDVDWDET6_7UBDiUF_o8XJ7vx0MPwEN3QprLwq4_1EKk74q4vI-UvfTskaNKZWi4CSbk_JeLcQrNIva3gNj-XYQd2YhwdtIJXR6o5a8puoSFGFCFkBxTadbQBrDn5IYO0hTpQJTEAcOYFHQB-WAN5eiKgHdQXrFfjcnKUMvKbT-DZ0p7oeGKOjELHS "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=182b6c8fd88f45fdb5ae78dee00bd06a&_e=EoMZZDf_A_jVI0NPrXUWHIiFu2kFb4aUzR3tytZvi7i7EfQFxqvn7Ify2DsMDayRyUcKqKQ5wYmX1WKvM2dQAskGhUiJThO93r4uBwcHE4pQcDOW52Ws7Ae1B56eO9ZvJMkKBHS8wkgHCjLB4PwPDEQlkuaNKnDPhk-ARnm8eqInFPeiexCRiPgkZooLEsH2sKK_yraFPwLvQus6Xm46JdirMD7SQTcc7-N3LG3pJDrMsgFFywXU_wTpuiq_gMbc6eK3cTwDVDWDET6_7UBDiUF_o8XJ7vx0MPwEN3QprLyEVR8VCr5_z9wiLmW81mhhJl7D3iLFkWavy1iVlRkmejoXjrWcyHEGjYMdLkNDriMgdCgC5L0MGW1cWlMqn3hdNqgjepTZDkFWXRJ8lpk2YNNyPMiqUjPec7lPgE9kjLD5_xTg9J0gmUGkJ8TYdtUu "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way— _and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---

---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=182b6c8fd88f45fdb5ae78dee00bd06a&_e=EoMZZDf_A_jVI0NPrXUWHIiFu2kFb4aUzR3tytZvi7i7EfQFxqvn7Ify2DsMDayRyUcKqKQ5wYmX1WKvM2dQAskGhUiJThO93r4uBwcHE4pQcDOW52Ws7Ae1B56eO9ZvJMkKBHS8wkgHCjLB4PwPDEQlkuaNKnDPhk-ARnm8eqInFPeiexCRiPgkZooLEsH2sKK_yraFPwLvQus6Xm46JdirMD7SQTcc7-N3LG3pJDrMsgFFywXU_wTpuiq_gMbc6eK3cTwDVDWDET6_7UBDiUF_o8XJ7vx0MPwEN3QprLyRFEbVY3pzsdAA76RSurWJvygesGUrMUxAhHThPmPPuOMn3n1S_uMCZZpOf9JhuXYuVbhyri1skm0qJct6c41ePdloBRhADPE1HMEwN6cip3RSRlvUaae51T9UZB147Jx8IdJArC6u7fNrAXLcc8y- "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Hi Derek, I’m personally reaching out because over the next week, you’re not going to hear much from me. I’ll be off the campaign trail and in Washington focusing on some important Congressional work. Of course, my team and I don’t want to leave you hanging. They’ll keep you up-to-date on my work and our fast-paced race here in VA-02. **The last time I was off the campaign trail, our fundraising took a severe nosedive – and that’s something we absolutely can’t afford this close to November. ****[_Please, will you split $5 between my campaign and Senator Warner's to make sure my team isn't scrambling to close a big fundraising gap in my absence?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52760794/373316533/-1100525210?refcode=mw_em_221017_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2N2U2ZDYyYi0yODRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7SKDVN2ZD1fBdf0trxQKVNA15S-KhXua7rqzNk2ddUc=)** **Truthfully, I hate to take time away from campaigning in the most competitive battleground district in the nation.** But my duty as a member of Congress isn’t to advance my own career. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW_2WCxhNk

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW_2WCxhNk

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60948424:W_2WCxhNk:m:3:2532013465:D7F32519E3FB37A20D1F34D9A124E6E6:r

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60948424:W_2WCxhNk:m:3:2532013465:D7F32519E3FB37A20D1F34D9A124E6E6:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

Peter,California is arguably some of the best and most beautiful land in our country. We have a the longest coastline in the country belonging to any single state in the lower forty-eight, thick forests, rolling plains, fertile soil, picturesque desert, warm sunny days and cool breezy nights.We also have HANDS DOWN the absolute WORST governor.
Every single policy put forth by Gavin Newsom has been absolutely devastating to the people of California. From his harsh, lockdown-loving response to COVID, to his recent legislation that actually makes it ILLEGAL for physicians to DISAGREE WITH POLITICIANS.Yes, you read that right. Physicians can now be punished for disagreeing with elected officials about coronavirus in the state of California.He's decriminalized prostitution because those laws "disproportionately punished people of color," so now sex workers are prowling neighborhoods in Oakland.His ridiculous gasoline-powered car ban is an unrealistic goal that even the CEO of Toyota spoke out against and called "hard to achieve." When the lockdowns started, his in-laws actually fled California for Florida, just like the many other tens of thousands we've seen leave the Golden State for greener pastures. I could go on and on about how inept this man is and everything he did that led to California having the third highest income inequality in the US, but I think you get the idea.

He was handed it by a man who has run our state into the ground. And trust me, Democrats and Republicans BOTH are frustrated with this choice. **Now, they get to have THEIR voices heard for the first time on the matter.** Every sign is showing us that there is going to be a very low Democratic turnout this November (just like 2014). body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv4hi2lgu88jd9l58u8ke6jkhfpnt2jccth2amro_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1h66o34cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zq7alo9f5704bj8gvebmchlp2s734caemnf6sgg0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1h66o34cjh2bs)**

| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5qh01si05lggtselkncelkei08pti5nqaa5u930_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1h66o34cjh2bs)
---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers

name: Raphael Warnock via Blue Amp Action
subject: At this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short
body:
The GOP is flooding the state to win this one
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | _Peter,_ Herschel Walker and I wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day. I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, **but we have a problem:** With experts at _FiveThirtyEight_ saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me. **[That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb29e3d42-67db-4c71-862b-a44692d91a51/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign. And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy
---
|

**Poll Workers** When we say "poll workers," we mean the people who check voters into the precinct location to vote, hands the voter their ballot or card for the ballot marking device (touch screen computer with ballot), tells the voter where to deposit the ballot in the ballot box, and closes the precinct location after voting is over. Your state may call this position one of the following titles: poll worker, election official, judge of elections, inspector of elections, judge, inspector, or some other similar title. These "poll workers" are generally hired at county level by the permanent employees who administer the elections and maintain voter rolls. Those permanent employees may hold one of the following titles: election supervisor, election board, board of elections, board of commissioners, county supervisors, county judges, etc. The titles vary from state to state. Generally speaking, if you want to work the election on Election Day or during early voting and be paid to work, you will need to reach out the county employee responsible for hiring those poll workers. **Poll Watchers** A poll watcher is the person who is in the voting precinct while voters vote, silently watching and observing the election process. If the poll watcher sees irregularities, the poll watcher will report those irregularities to the entity (i.e., county political party) that assigned the poll watcher position based on the training received by that entity (county political party).

| | A [series of lethal crimes](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._VGLLCZ1JA) broke out in major U.S. cities in just one week, underscoring the ineffectiveness of Democrat crime policies. It’s no wonder that more than three-quarters of voters say that violent crime is a major problem, according to a new [Politico/Morning Consult poll](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.). In New York, for example, a 53-year-old father visiting his son at Marist College was gunned down in a suburban New York hotel by two homeless men wanted for other crimes and who had bomb-making materials in their hotel room. This crime is just one example of even more caused by the state’s experimentation with cashless bail, a policy that has spurred an increase in repeat offenders. Likewise, the iconic Las Vegas Strip turned into a danger zone when a Guatemalan [man illegally in the United States](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTM5JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/Brjmin-1zX0IesbfwO-Pzw) knifed eight victims, killing two. Tourists and entertainers were afraid to return to the streets. "We're all really distraught — it happened on one of the safer locations on the Strip and at 11 o'clock in the morning," said showgirl [Mikayla Yegge](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bOsuMOI9uYsF4l_66Q). With just one month until election day, voters can help to reverse the Democrats’ disastrous course on crime by electing responsible representatives to Congress.

Then click on the button that says “Start Texting!” That’s it! You’ll then receive a text message on your cell phone that includes a link for you to get started. That link will take you to the instructions, and you can begin right away!

In fact, over the past year, DHS has provided cell phones to more than 255,000 illegal aliens released into the United States in order to track their whereabouts, costing Americans more than $360,000 per day. But the administration’s Alternatives to Detention (ATD) tracking program has ballooned by 880 percent since Fiscal Year 2021, as the total number of illegal border crossers has grown to over 3.3 million. clean_body: | | | | | You know the old saying, friend: “If at first you don’t succeed, lie, lie again.” - Malinowski, probably Well, that might not be the actual saying, but it seems to be the one Malinowski is living by. We thought for sure after the first shellacking he took on the debate stage last week, that he wouldn’t want to embarrass himself in front of New Jersey AGAIN, but that’s exactly what he did last night. Malinowski can weave whatever web of lies he’d like on stage, but unfortunately for him New Jerseyans remember things that happened in the real world: ❌ He got caught trading $1,000,000 in stocks during the pandemic, and is STILL under investigation by the House Ethics Committee ❌ He voted for every crazy spending bill that wrecked our economy and made life less affordable ❌ He supports raising taxes EVEN HIGHER than what we already pay Meanwhile, Tom Kean: ✅ Has always been a champion for ethics and standing up to corruption✅ Will work to rein in spending and get inflation under control✅ Presented a plan to make life affordable in New Jersey Last night’s debate was a major momentum boost for our campaign. Welcome back to another Russell's Roundup, your weekly source... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/russellfrysc/russells-roundup-1017?e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=fb6773efa2&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| October 17, 2022
---
| | Friends,

Welcome back to another _**Russell's Roundup**_ , your weekly source for the latest on Russell Fry's campaign to Congress to take back the House!

---
|
---
| [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=1d6b306e1b&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**#RussellontheRoad** I spent two awesome days in Florence, Dillon, and Marion County last week. It was great to get back on the road again and see all of my friends in parts of the Pee Dee!
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=8c347a57bf&e=7aa6ac5965)
---

**Florence County**
I had so much fun spending the day in Florence, but I have to say the highlight of the day was getting a behind-the-scenes tour at Buc-ee's. We were met with such enthusiasm and hospitality from all of their team members!
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=1e1c98e32a&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**Dillon & Marion County**
It was great to be back in Dillon and Marion again! I kicked off the day by meeting with Marion County Sheriff Wallace and part of his team, had lunch at Breaking Bread with community leaders and business owners in Dillon, visited Baxley Farms, spoke at the Marion County GOP monthly meeting, and finished the night off at the famous T-Roy's.
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=2daf37bf6c&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**In The News **
Last week I joined The Wilkow Majority with Andrew Wilkow on Sirius XM Patriot 125, where we discussed my op-ed in The Washington Times on the opioid crisis and the terrifying effect of Fentanyl that's pouring across our border.

Listen to the full interview [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=f402aeb948&e=7aa6ac5965).
---
|
---
| [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=ec5f8339c2&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**LORIS BOG-OFF**
We had a GREAT day at the annual Loris Bog-Off Festival, and let me tell you it was packed! My team and I had so much fun cooking chicken bog, competing in the bog-off, and meeting people from all across the Grand Strand and the Pee Dee.
|
---
---
| | **WE NEED YOU! **
This election isn't going to win itself. We need everything you can give to dethrone the Democrats! Click [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=8f2c61e498&e=7aa6ac5965) to donate.

**Pssst! PASS IT ON!**
Help spread the word of what Russell is doing here in the 7th Congressional District. Please take a moment and forward this newsletter to 10 of your neighbors, relatives, co-workers, and friends. They’ll be glad you did!

**COUNTDOWN TO ELECTION DAY!**
There are just **_22_ **days until November 8. Mark your calendars and get ready to head to the polls!

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MONDAY, OCTOBER 17
PHOTO RELEASE: CITIZENS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA KNOCKS OVER 500 DOORS FOR KEMP, KING, HAUSMANN (ATLANTA) - This weekend, Citizens for a Greater Georgia partnered with the Atlanta Young Republicans for a day of action on behalf of Governor Brian Kemp, Insurance Commissioner John King, and Republican nominee for Senate District 14 Liz Hausmann. Three dozen volunteers came out to rally alongside former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler, King, and Hausmann - and went on to knock more than 500 doors across the north Fulton area.

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6429%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=aXLK%2fpxIoU93Xxvq4iJ1YQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77567%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FAyCWLa%2bAnT8Mbh0lsWItQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. I’ve defended LGBTQ+ rights from the Trump Administration’s attacks as Attorney General, helped the first LGBTQ+ couples in Pennsylvania marry as a Montgomery County Commissioner, and pushed to expand protections for our Commonwealth’s LGBTQ+ communities as a State Representative.
As Governor, I’m committed to finally banning discrimation against LGBTQ+ individuals in Pennsylvania so that they can work, attend school, and seek housing with the same rights and protections as everyone else in the Commonwealth. body:
TAMPA, Fla. – The Republican nominee for Congress in Florida’s 14th Congressional District Monday announced that he has received the endorsement of... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e9f914890003/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13689788?e=00028e5542)
---
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=b85d0b74da&e=00028e5542)
[**James Judge endorsed by former Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=ca6c2e6607&e=00028e5542)
TAMPA, Fla. – The Republican nominee for Congress in Florida’s 14th Congressional District Monday announced that he has received the endorsement of former Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats.“I’m thrilled to endorse James Judge for Congress in Florida’s 14th Congressional District,” said Coats. “Over the course of his campaign, James has demonstrated his unwavering commitment and support for law enforcement. He has already been endorsed by several prominent law enforcement figures, and I am proud to add my name to that list.Coats was first elected Sheriff of Pinellas County in 2004, after being appointed to the role on an interim basis by Gov. Jeb Bush. He served his community for more than 40 years.But that 40 years of service did not only include police work.Coats was well known for volunteering his time and served on the Executive Board of the Boys and Girls Club in Pinellas County for 18 years. He also served on the Executive Board of Directors several other organizations, including Big Brothers Big Sisters of Pinellas County, Clothes to Kids and the Pinellas County Police Athletic League.“I am extremely grateful and humbled by Sheriff Coats’s endorsement,” said Judge. “He is a role model and embodies the very spirit of public service. When I’m in Congress, I hope to be able to serve the Tampa Bay area as well as Sheriff Coats did for more than 40 years.”Judge is facing off with Democrat Rep. Kathy Castor, who supported an anti-police bill that would hamstring and defund law enforcement. He is strong on fighting violent crime, and has earned the endorsements of current Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri and the Tampa Police Benevolent Association.He recently earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times and has been endorsed by several high-profile local and national figures.Judge’s other endorsees include Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, the Community Patriots Tampa, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

**[FirstName,Fallback=Patriot], what 's being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they're BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

This can't go on. I won't allow it.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama's corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama's illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents - AND WIN!**

And now I'm pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden's rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I 'm doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

Friend, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $10, $25, $50, $100, or even more. If you've given before, please give again. If you can, give more than you've ever given to Freedom Watch.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zpaal66v09ojdofvtvdv1fef35r94ogm36vcdnmg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1j6cpb4sth2bs)

I can't do it without you, [FirstName,Fallback=Patriot].

Thank you for doing whatever you can now.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Friend, I'm heartbroken after reading that powerful letter from our fellow patriots who are rotting in jail in Washington, D.C. **These are innocent men and women, tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $5, $10, $25, $50, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Each dollar counts.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zkqiuhme4r2vhuq1fltmkgtt25g56shft94r6u8g_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1j6cpb4sth2bs)

**Free the January 6 Protestors!**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping innocent Americans in jail without due process...they're often abused and beaten...they're blocked from seeing their wives and children...and kept from seeing their lawyers and clergy!

At least one January 6 protestor has already died.

And another protester, a patriot grandma with cancer, just finished serving 60 days in federal prison for a crime she didn't commit.

[But there's something you can do about it ...you can donate immediately to Freedom Watch's critically important lawsuit to HELP FREE the rest of these persecuted patriots with your crucial gift today.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zcasi4l5e27kc7k6g8sbiplf0i1h8pljpdhjsub0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1j6cpb4sth2bs)

# Log Cabin Republicans Endorsement

Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from the Log Cabin Republicans.

The Log Cabin Republicans is the nation's original and largest organization representing LGBT conservatives and straight allies who support fairness, freedom, and equality for all Americans. Log Cabin Republicans has state and local chapters nationwide, full-time staff in Washington, DC, a federal political action committee, and state political action committees.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Charles T. Moran, President of Log Cabin Republicans, said:
"Erik Aadland is a father, husband, and esteemed servicemember who is committed to put Colorado first and fight back against the corrupt establishment. Erik's passion to serve his community is honorable and truly indicative of the type of representative he will be for his constituents. Log Cabin Republicans is honored to endorse Erik Aadland in his bid to represent Colorado's 7th congressional district, knowing that he will fight to secure our southern border, care for our veterans, address climate change, get our economy back on track, and protect our individual liberties."

**Patriot, what’s being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

This can’t go on. I won’t allow it.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!**

And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $10, $25, $50, $100, or even more. If you’ve given before, please give again. If you can, give more than you’ve ever given to Freedom Watch.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zku5m12n29ggut6rekvv3k2ugpr0jt27g8ku2v80_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1j6ao34cjh2bs)

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can now.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, I’m heartbroken after reading that powerful letter from our fellow patriots who are rotting in jail in Washington, D.C. **These are innocent men and women, tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $5, $10, $25, $50, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Each dollar counts.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbe062al6v8kh0hjusk279nbcafdubclcberh50o_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1j6ao34cjh2bs)

**

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zc2sdtgo0v7v5u8srrp4taft46dppruo4pcioqe0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1j66pr4sph2bs)**

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

Peter, the GOP nominee for Missouri's open Senate seat, Eric Schmitt, likes to talk a lot about his working-class roots.**But the only time he actually thinks about working families is when he's reading off the talking points his Washington consultants wrote for him.**
You see, Eric Schmitt has spent his career in politics making life harder for everyday families here in Missouri. He turned his back on family farms when he voted to let oligarchs from Communist China buy up Missouri farmlands. He attacks our unions and has repeatedly voted to gut collective bargaining protections. He filed a lawsuit to let health insurance companies charge Missouri women and seniors more for healthcare. And when the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, it only took him six minutes to make Missouri the first state in the country to enforce an extreme, out-of-touch trigger ban on abortion.
It's no secret why Eric Schmitt is leaving working families behind. He's taken _thousands_ in gifts from lobbyists and campaign contributions from special interests. **In short, he sold out working families. He sold out the people he swore to represent. And he sold out Missouri.**
**Being a good leader isn't about where you come from or who your family is. It's about who you fight for and what you do with the power that's given to you.**
Trudy Busch Valentine has spent her life serving her community as a nurse, a children's advocate, and a hospice volunteer.** Now, she's running for Senate to defeat Eric Schmitt and expand our Democratic majority.** Trudy will never sell out Missourians, and she'll put people before politics _every. single. time._

name: Tulsi Gabbard
subject: Why I endorsed Joe Kent
body:
Dear Peter,
The Democrat Party that I joined -- the party of JFK and MLK, the 'big tent' inclusive party that fought for free speech, freedom of religion, civil liberties and peace --no longer exists. It is now under the complete control of an elitist cabal of warmongers who oppose freedom and take every opportunity to undermine our Constitution. That's why I can no longer call myself a Democrat.
And that's also why I am doing all I can to send Joe Kent to Congress, and why I'm urging you to do the same by donating at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/1XBbeFyddp7763763763vLRpyCtw/67f7o9ra763U9YwWi763qqlIqw).
Like me, Joe is an army veteran. And like me, he understands the danger posed by complete control of our government by so-called 'woke' fanatical ideologues like Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi.
Joe's opponent in this race, Marie Perez, is no different. She supports open borders, allowing fentanyl and cartels to continue to put American lives at risk. She supports new gun control laws that infringe on our Second Amendment rights and will prevent Americans from purchasing the same firearms she herself already owns.
Worst of all, she would be another so-called 'woke' Democrat voting in lock-step to push our country farther down the destructive path we've been on for the last two years: more record inflation, record gas prices, open borders, and rampant crime.
The only person standing in Marie Perez's way is Joe Kent, and he needs your help. Join me in supporting him by contributing at [JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/iXjfOYD5qNxIPb9W9Ifm6g/67f7o9ra763U9YwWi763qqlIqw).
Thank you.
Tulsi Gabbard

body:
We know we’ve been sending a lot of emails lately, but there’s an important reason.
#
Derek, okay we know we’re sending you yet another email. But there’s an important reason and we’re hoping you’ll hear us out. 🥺
October 19 is our last FEC deadline before the election — which means we’ll have to post our fundraising numbers one last time before the midterms.
**Between Dr. Oz + GOP super PACs, we’re already being massively outspent.** Dr. Oz raised $17 million last quarter (which included $7 million from his own personal fortune) — plus dark money PACs, including Donald Trump’s, are pouring millions more into this race to try to buy this seat.
Unlike Oz, John doesn’t have million$ to personally fund his campaign — instead, he is relying on grassroots contributions from supporters like you.
**[Will you help us post strong fundraising numbers in one of the most critical moments of this election yet by making a contribution of any amount today? We’re hoping to reach 100,000 unique contributions by October 19 — and your contribution right now will help us get there.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221017-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221017-7766&refcode2=7766_434096_pvx8ZS&akid=7766%2E434096%2Epvx8ZS)**

Thank you for your support today,
Team Fetterman 💛

Friends,
I feel really good about where we are in this campaign.
At 100,000 people and growing, we’ve got the biggest volunteer organizing team in the country right now. And these volunteers are already at the doors of Texas voters, building relationships and connecting with those who will decide the outcome of this election.
Our digital team is leveraging our social media presence to reach voters — especially young voters — with the messages that give them a reason to care about and vote in this election. It’s also been a powerful recruitment tool to bring in new volunteers.
And Abbott continues to make the case for why he can’t be trusted with another term in office. Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers, six major mass shootings on his watch, or the outright banning of reproductive health care freedom in Texas, he’s given Texas voters — Republicans as well as Democrats — plenty of reasons to vote for change.
The polls are starting to show it as well. A new one has us within just four points — and within the margin of error — of Abbott.
The only place where I know we could be doing better is fundraising.
While we’ve kept pace with Abbott on a day to day basis, matching his corporate donors with grassroots support, we started this race more than $50 million behind. I really need us to redouble our commitment to meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to have the resources to win.
As we continue organizing everywhere, I hope that you’ll consider splitting a donation between our campaign and Seth Moulton. I need to make sure that we maximize the momentum we have, the progress we’re making and this extraordinary chance before us to win. Three weeks after the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School, I went to Newtown
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct22.6iboAv&refcode=em221017-1-15&refcode2=2622.3935704.EA3lpJ&t=1&akid=2622%2E3935704%2EEA3lpJ)

_My visit to Newtown, Connecticut._
Friends -
Three weeks after the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School, I went to Newtown and met personally with many of the families who lost loved ones, and others who had kids in the school that day.
I think about that day often—especially as we are weeks away from electing a new set of leaders with the power to act on the issue of gun violence.
I think about the parents who gave us a magnet with a photo of their child that we attached to the microwave of our Tucson home.
I think about the educator who survived the attack and was released from the hospital right before coming to our meeting.
And every time I hear of another school shooting, I am brought back to that day.
All of us are, no doubt.
The news doesn’t cover gun violence on a daily basis, but it is an issue that impacts countless Americans every day.
It could be a family that is still grieving the loss or injury of a loved one, or a family just receiving news that will change their lives forever.
But please know that while this issue isn’t always top-of-mind, it is something I am working on every day.
I will NEVER give up until we have done all we can to make our communities safer from gun violence. But I cannot do that alone. I need your help.

## About Aadland For Congress

| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no Fat-Cat donors from California and New York, or shady philanthropists backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

clean_body: | | | | Hi Friend, I’m writing you today to urge you to support my friend and true supporter, Senate candidate Kim Rice. She is running for the Oregon Senate District 18 which serves Beaverton, Aloha, South Hillsboro, Scholls, and Midway in the rural county. Her district is a beautiful blend of agricultural and urban area that is impacted by the horrible Democrat policies that have promulgated crime, drugs, and homelessness. Oregonians deserve better! Here’s why you’re going to love Kim: Like me, she is a fighter. She stood against the mandates, lost her teaching job, and then decided to take her fight to Salem. She is running to restore “We the People” and the land. Kim is a true conservative. She is running for God, Family, and Country. She understands that every part of our American way of life is under attack from the Marxist, progressive left. Kim knows that this is still America and that we must uphold our Constitutional rights and that the power lies in the people. And that is why she is fighting hard for her seat. Kim’s race is an uphill battle: she is facing a seated Democrat and a fake “Independent” who is actually a D-leaning career Republican politician. (For the record, Democrats are not happy with the state of their cities either!) Our tribe has had ENOUGH of fake, woke, and entrenched. We need people like Kim! When I was running for governor, Kim was an ardent supporter. She gave contributions to my campaign, canvassed her district to get my message to the voters, and helped plant signs in Washington County. Join me in energy, prayer, and resources to help Kim win for all Oregonians. Here’s her website: Here are 3 simple ways to help: 1\. Donate: be a part of taking back a Senate seat in Oregon! 2\. Follow Kim on social media at facebook.com/KimRiceForOregon or on Instagram @kimfororegon 3\. Share her posts and invite your friends to her pages – this is how we grassroots freedom-lovers take back our state: we support our friends! Thank you for helping Kim Rice SD 18 fight to restore our state. Best wishes, Marc Thielman | JOIN US | | | | ELEGRAM PAID FOR BY THE MARC FOR OREGON COMMITTEE Marc For Oregon P.O. body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2znmnd98thbtr900rhh978q2l6joejalplbc4g8f8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1gm0ob5cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbo66ddlcmr36s30s1h6ddhjmuq71pr0s1hj9crlmkrb5chjmmqe5c5kecp34d9gcv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664obbc37m8o6cdb4mmr3fc5lclp2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zj16g07fgm1m2505il7ou2bgsns029qdmu47ifbo_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1gm0ob5cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Let me tell you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Scrap by scrap, inch by inch, foot by foot, mile by mile.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221017-3503-header&t=1&akid=3503%2E2526796%2Em01WvY)
You may have noticed an uptick in our emails inviting you to attend virtual phonebanks — and if you live near the district, door knocking.
Door knocking and phonebanking are the best tools for reaching voters where they’re at, having meaningful conversations, and making impactful connections.
But I know for organizers and volunteers — people like you — it can feel nerve wracking, especially the first time. So I wanted to talk to you a little about how important it is to just show up.
During my first campaign, I remember one time when I was phonebanking, a young woman picked up and said, “You know, you all came to my door a week ago. And I didn't answer it, but I've been thinking about it ever since. And now you're calling me and I want you to know that you have my vote.” Woo!
So again showing up counts, showing up is what matters. And understand that when you get out there on the streets, you are not alone — you are part of a generation and a lineage of people who have always fought to make this world better. Scrap by scrap, inch by inch, foot by foot, mile by mile. And I want to thank you for doing that because things like this are what matters.
With our election just 23 days away, we could use your help.
1. [If you’d like to join us on the streets, or virtually, check out our upcoming volunteer events and sign up here.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/2918?utm_source=em20221017-3503-P_ORG_VOL_GRM&t=2&akid=3503%2E2526796%2Em01WvY)
2. [If you’re able to, please pitch in to our campaign here so we can continue recruiting and training more volunteers to have these important conversations.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221017.xhH0CY&refcode=em20221017-3503-P_ORG_VOL_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3503%2E2526796%2Em01WvY)

Hi Peter, I wanted to give you an update on where I’ve been the past few days! With the Senate out of session until November, I am happy to be back home in Wisconsin. I’ve been lucky enough to be on the road across our great state, campaigning for Democrats running up and down the ballot! **Take a look at what I’ve been up to, and[if you can, chip in a few dollars so I can keep up these campaign stops!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52801116/373423197/804099807?refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221017_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Njk1MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNmU2YzQ3NS02NzRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pv1myXqOyK4JL6--Y9i0aaj-R9g2HXNR3GbPtmb1VCo=)** I stopped in La Crosse to campaign with my friend, Brad Pfaff, running for Congress in Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional district. His opponent was at the insurrection at our Capitol on January 6 — we can’t let folks like that serve in Congress. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52801117/373423198/804099807?refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221017_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Njk1MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNmU2YzQ3NS02NzRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pv1myXqOyK4JL6--Y9i0aaj-R9g2HXNR3GbPtmb1VCo=) In West Allis, we rallied in support of _Roe v. Wade_. It’s abundantly clear that only one candidate for U.S. Senate is going to defend reproductive freedoms — and it’s not Ron Johnson! body:
There are just over three weeks until Election Day
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52801675/373424644/-1540418300?refcode=jtk1579-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNjIzMzZjMC02NzRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnyDQdSLRrhtJM8nCM4X7YIWofCVxA6w3ZBgp8bIFUY=)

Peter,

New Mexico communities raised me – from the moment I took my very first steps to the day I walked across the stage to accept my college diploma.
Growing up in New Mexico, I met friends and neighbors who were kind, innovative, and resilient – but it was clear that our elected officials weren’t doing enough to support families and harness our state’s full potential.
That's why I've dedicated my entire life to giving back to the state that raised me, first as the Director of the Aging and Long-Term Services Department, then as a U.S. Congresswoman, and now as the first Democratic Hispanic woman to be elected Governor.
[**There are just over three weeks until Election Day, and I'm asking if you'll contribute to my ambitious $75,000 mid-month goal to defend myself from GOP attack ads and pull ahead. Let me explain why**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52801676/373424645/-1540418300?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1579-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNjIzMzZjMC02NzRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnyDQdSLRrhtJM8nCM4X7YIWofCVxA6w3ZBgp8bIFUY=)**:**
**Since my election in 2018, New Mexico has become a beacon of hope and a blueprint for change**. My successful push to legalize cannabis has been a major influence on the Biden administration’s move toward federal decriminalization.
I took bold action to enshrine a woman’s right to make reproductive choices into law and made sure that the Land of Enchantment could be a safe haven for those facing persecution in neighboring states.
And I made it my responsibility to safeguard future generations' chances for success, both by signing a law to provide free higher education for all and jumpstarting New Mexico's transition from greenhouse gas reliance.
**But if we want New Mexico to continue clearing the path to progress, I need your help.** My extremist opponent is hellbent on reversing all of our advances and dragging New Mexico back in time. What’s more, he’s got the backing of top GOP leaders and their millions in dark money behind him. And now, a recent poll shows us _too close for comfort_.
With so much on the line, we can't risk leaving anything to chance.

**New Mexico communities deserve a leader who will raise them up, as they have done for me. I’ve dedicated my career to fighting for a brighter future for our state – but I need your help to see this promise through.[So, Peter, can I please count on your contribution of $5 today to power this campaign to the finish line and keep New Mexico on the path to progress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52801677/373424646/-1540418300?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1579-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNjIzMzZjMC02NzRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnyDQdSLRrhtJM8nCM4X7YIWofCVxA6w3ZBgp8bIFUY=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52801678/373424647/-1540418300?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1579-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNjIzMzZjMC02NzRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnyDQdSLRrhtJM8nCM4X7YIWofCVxA6w3ZBgp8bIFUY=)
**_This is me back when I was a U.S. Representative. No matter my title, I'll never stop fighting for New Mexicans._**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

We’re tired of the hypocrisy coming from corporate Democrats. Nancy Pelosi
and Democratic leaders can’t claim they disagree with Republicans while
they fight progressives tooth and nail on the same issues.

This is the same House Democratic leadership that:

* Blacklisted vendors who work with progressives
* Allows millions of dark money spending against progressives
* Campaigned for an anti-abortion incumbent challenged by a progressive
* Calls progressives who support bold policies like Medicare for All
“divisive”

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/118263?refcode=em20221017-25596&t=1002&akid=25596%2E1203867%2E7UWcJb ]We don’t have millions in dark money to spend – we have supporters like
you. Can we count on your support to transform the Democratic Party from
the inside out?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/118263?refcode=em20221017-25596&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=25596%2E1203867%2E7UWcJb ]Contribute

We remember the DCCC blacklist & how far Democratic leaders went to stop
progressives. We’ve seen the influence of their dark money cycle after
cycle with Justice Democrats like Jessica Cisneros, Kina Collins, and
Summer Lee.

Democratic leaders Nancy Pelosi, Steny Hoyer, James Clyburn, and Hakeem
Jeffries all campaigned for Henry Cuellar, the only anti-choice Democrat
in the House. Jessica Cisneros lost to Cuellar by a razor thin margin.

From the start, our candidates have helped make Medicare for All a
mainstream issue, but Democratic leaders have fought against it time and
time again – in campaigns and in Congress.

We know their hypocrisy better than anyone, which is why we’re working to
elect grassroots progressives who won’t be beholden to anyone but the
people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/118263?refcode=em20221017-25596&t=1022&akid=25596%2E1203867%2E7UWcJb ]We’re asking you to donate today so we can continue to fight for you
(since Nancy Pelosi won’t). Can you help us elect new Justice Democrats
next month?

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=25596%2E1203867%2E7UWcJb ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the

It's the _honor of my life_ to be the Pastor of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8605.1.84961b2e8625981b753f605104a2cab0) in Tulsa, OK.
God has blessed our church with **tremendous growth**.
Last year, we launched a second Sunday service to make room for the growth.
Currently, we have services every Sunday at 9 & 11 am as well as Wednesday at 7pm.
**Our current location has been amazing, but we are outgrowing it.**
On Sundays at 11 am, I will find myself in the church lobby watching cars circle our parking lot trying to find a place to park because we have run out of parking before the service even begins and as a Pastor that's a horrible thing to see because your heart's desire is to reach people.
Last year, we began seeking the Lord for _direction_ on addressing this good problem.
God has poured out His favor on [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8606.1.42af6bfd0ddb7c5ea13dbacb08a99134)!
We have **acquired 6 acres in South Tulsa** between 81st and 91st off of Memorial.
I approached the owner of the 8 acres attached to the 6 acres we have acquired and asked what he would sell it to [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8607.1.fcf6f732cce50ac96325ed16128e3818) for and his response was reasonable. He said, "$750,000."
I then asked him if he would take $100,000 and he said, "**yes**."
**That's a MIRACLE!**
We are in a position to purchase 8 acres of prime real estate in South Tulsa for $100,000 that could be the potential home of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8608.1.58c2f5d46dab750e4a411edc63f42123) in the future.
Currently, [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8609.1.97fd6e96f56cc8c19f212c15c3619812) is debt free, and I believe we should remain debt free.
**In order to remain out of debt, I need your help.**
We need to raise $100,000 over the next 60 days.
**So far, we have raised $70,000!**
I'm asking for you to come partner with what God is doing through [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8610.1.a08662e4545c7545460ddf2b4b1a4a61) and help expand the Kingdom of God.
A gift of $5 or $500 will be a HUGE help.
**If everyone that this email goes out to does something, we will have more than enough to acquire the 8 acres in cash.**
God is doing great things at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8611.1.da2ad7dc451527d8b5870ce879e9b8ed), and I believe if you help bless God's house that in-return God will bless your house.
Please ask the Lord if this is a project that you should partner with us in.
You can partner with us by visiting [www.sheridan.church/give](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14765536.8612.1.3690c79ba514a66f1b84cf66f753e37e) and know that I am beyond grateful for your help.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

# About Nancy
---
Congresswoman Nancy Mace grew up in the Lowcountry. She is the daughter of a retired Army General and retired school teacher. Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. | | Friend, We have seen it and we are feeling it – record high inflation and consumers who are spending less. We are in the depths of a recession that is only going to get worse. Lauren Underwood’s solution? Higher taxes and higher fees. During her tenure she:
* Supported the Green New Deal that will hike energy costs
* Voted to hike taxes on working families
* Pushed mandates that cost farmers dearly

Lauren Underwood has made inflation worse and taxes higher, and her policies have led to millions of Americans paying more and losing billions from their retirement savings. Lauren Underwood has failed her constituents. In Congress, Scott Gryder will lead with common sense. Scott will oppose the Green New Deal policies that will send utility bills through the roof. Scott Gryder will work to cut taxes and spending, and get our country back on track. However, he needs your help to get there. | | | Dear Peter,

We're in the home stretch. Team Gibbs cannot thank you enough for your support and encouragement. Thank you for walking in parades, attending door launches and events, phone banking, and of course, your prayers! Your dedication is helping to bring this campaign to victory.

**We have 3 weeks** **left.** John Gibbs and conservative candidates all across Michigan need your continued support to secure victory on November 8th. Let's keep radical-left Democrats like Hillary Scholten out of office. Now is the time to join the movement, if you haven't already!

There's so much you can do! Please see **'Upcoming Events'** below for more details on how to get involved with events, door knocking, and phone banking.

Sincerely,

Team Gibbs

Mitch McConnell's super PACs are spending millions to blanket the airwaves with nasty attack ads to tip the scales in the GOP's favor. Now, with just weeks to go until Election Day, polling shows our races are neck and neck.
**That's why I'm directly asking for your help today. The only way we can counter the GOP's attacks is with an immediate surge in grassroots support. The only way we can counter the GOP's attacks is with an immediate surge in grassroots support. So please, friend:= It's no secret how much is at stake this November. Reproductive rights, voting rights, health care, our very democracy – it's all on the line. I'm proud to stand with Catherine, Maggie, and Mark in these critical fights for justice, and I know we can continue delivering for the working people. But I'll be blunt: We can't keep the Senate blue and build on our progress unless we protect these Democratic seats. So please, friend, I'm counting on you to step up right away: = Today and always, I'm so incredibly grateful for your grassroots support. clean_body: Each cent that you can donate would mean a ton to me and this fight for American workers. | | Derek -- JD Vance pretends to be your average Ohioan, but he couldn’t be more out of touch -- and with CNN ranking this seat as one of the most likely to flip blue, Ohioans need someone they can count on, someone who’s in this work to make a positive change. Tonight, I’m going to take the debate stage to show everyone why JD will never be that person. Derek, before I get on stage -- and ahead of Wednesday’s deadline -- can I count on you to split a $10 donation to the DNC and my campaign? With our razor-thin Senate majority, I guarantee you each cent would mean a whole lot right now. ** This is one of the closest races in the country, Derek. This race will decide whether I can go to Washington, D.C. to make life easier for Ohio workers and invest in good, solid jobs for working Americans. If it doesn’t swing our way, we’re in danger of sending JD Vance -- an extreme Republican who wants to push a nationwide abortion ban and make it harder to vote -- to the Senate. We cannot let this happen. My debate is tonight and one of the last FEC deadlines of this election is just days away, so I need to know I can rely on you to do the right thing and stand with me and Ohio workers. It'd mean the world to me. name: Raphael Warnock via Blue Amp Action
subject: Early voting’s started in Georgia
body:
We need your help to keep this seat
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | _Peter,_ Herschel Walker and I wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day, and early voting has now started in Georgia. I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, **but we have a problem:** With experts at _FiveThirtyEight_ saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me. **[That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf4552e75-ffd3-4d1e-80b9-8d86ff37b1bf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign. And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy
---
|
---
| | | | | | [**[ Re-Elect Raphael Warnock → ]**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Taf92df3d-97fb-40bc-93a6-b4030d6c597a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---

From the very start, I’ve relied entirely on grassroots folks like you to power us to victory – so I have to urgently ask you in this important moment: **[Before the midnight deadline, will you split a donation between Blue Amp Action and me to help hit our fundraising goal, win in Georgia, and keep the Senate blue?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tca89c171-53b0-489f-8c30-723115a404b6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** It means so much to have you by my side. | **PARSON WON'T ISSUE BLANKET PARDONS FOR MARIJUANA OFFENSES**
Shortly after President Joe Biden issued a blanket pardon on Oct. 6 to all those convicted of simple possession of marijuana under federal law and encouraged governors to do the same with state-level offenses, Gov. Mike Parson indicated he won’t follow suit.

“Governor Parson has used his state constitutional authority to grant pardons to individuals who demonstrate a changed lifestyle, commitment to rehabilitation, contrition and contribution to their communities rather than as a blanket approach to undermine existing law,” the governor’s spokeswoman said in a statement, according to the Missouri Independent.

Missouri voters could have the final say on whether the criminal records of low-level marijuana offenders are cleared when Amendment 3 to legalize recreational marijuana use by adults age 21 and older appears on the Nov. 8 statewide ballot. The measure includes provisions authorizing the automatic expungement of all criminal records for those convicted of non-violent marijuana offenses, excluding driving while under the influence and underage possession.
