| **VOTERS TO DECIDE IF TIME IS RIGHT FOR CONSTITUTIONAL REWRITE**
Missouri voters on Nov. 8 will decide whether to call a special convention to overhaul or replace the 77-year-old state constitution. The question automatically appears on the general election ballot every 20 years and simply asks: “Shall there be a convention to revise and amend the constitution”?

Missouri voters strongly rejected calling a convention the last three times the question was on the ballot, most recently in 2002 when just 34.5 percent were in favor. The question also failed in 1962, with 36.3 percent in support, and 1982, when just 30.5 percent of voters were in favor. As is the case this year, there were no organized campaigns for or against in those prior elections.

If voters approve the convention question this time, delegate elections would be held early next year. There would be 83 delegates in all, with 68 delegates – 34 Democrats and 34 Republicans – essentially chosen by the local political party committees in each of Missouri’s state Senate districts. The remaining 15 delegates would be elected statewide by voters, creating the possibility – and perhaps probability in the Republican-dominated state – that a single party could sweep those positions and dominate the convention.

The convention would operate independently of the Missouri General Assembly and would even have the power to appropriate money to pay for its expenses without legislative approval. Delegates could choose to propose an entirely new constitution or simply offer amendments to the existing one, just as the legislature already regularly does.

There is no timetable for how long a convention could last, but no vote could be held on a new constitution or proposed amendments until after the convention adjourned. The convention would set a special election to take place no sooner than 60 days, and not later than six months, after final adjournment. Ratification of a new constitution or individual amendments would require simple majority support.

Missouri voters last approved calling a convention in 1942 with 57.9 percent in support following a bipartisan campaign by business, political and academic leaders stressing the need to replace the Reconstruction-era state constitution enacted in 1875. The resulting convention lasted a little over a year and produced Missouri’s current constitution, which took effect shortly after voters ratified it with 62.7 percent support in February 1945.

Voters, with 55.4 percent support, also approved calling a constitutional convention in 1920. After proceedings spanning 18 months, that convention failed to agree on full constitutional rewrite and instead referred 21 individual amendments to voters, who ratified just six.

Of the four state constitutions Missouri has had since the first was ratified in 1820, the current Constitution has been in use the longest, and voters have amended it 131 times. Another four proposed amendments will appear on this year’s ballot.
---
|
---
| **JUDGE DISMISSES CHALLENGE TO PHOTO VOTER ID REQUIREMENT**
Cole County Judge Jon Beetem on Oct. 12 dismissed a lawsuit challenging Missouri’s new photo voter identification mandate after ruling the plaintiffs lack the legal standing to bring it. Although a direct appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is expected, barring its swift intervention, voters will be required to produce a government-issued photo ID in order to cast a ballot in the Nov. 8 general election.

The state Supreme Court has twice struck down previous photo voter ID laws for unconstitutionally interfering with voting rights, but Beetem didn’t reach the merits of the arguments in the current case. Instead, he determined the only two individual voters named as plaintiffs failed to show they are harmed by the law since both have government-issued photo IDs they can use to vote in the upcoming Nov. 8 elections. Beetem also said the main plaintiffs – the Missouri chapters of the League of Women Voters and the NAACP – likewise lack standing since the harm they alleged their members would suffer is too speculative.

The Republican-controlled General Assembly enacted the photo ID requirement earlier this year as part of larger legislation, House Bill 1878, aimed at restricting voting access. A second lawsuit, also brought by the League of Women Voters and the NAACP, challenging other aspects of the bill remains pending before Beetem, a Republican.

The lawsuit alleges certain provisions of the bill violate free speech rights by placing tight restrictions on voter registrations drives and banning people from encouraging or assisting others to cast an absentee ballot.

Parson indicated he won’t follow suit. | | | | | | | Capitol Report October 17, 2022 | | | | Contact Senator Roberts 201 W. Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | PARSON WON'T ISSUE BLANKET PARDONS FOR MARIJUANA OFFENSES Shortly after President Joe Biden issued a blanket pardon on Oct. 6 to all those convicted of simple possession of marijuana under federal law and encouraged governors to do the same with state-level offenses, Gov. Mike Parson indicated he won’t follow suit. “Governor Parson has used his state constitutional authority to grant pardons to individuals who demonstrate a changed lifestyle, commitment to rehabilitation, contrition and contribution to their communities rather than as a blanket approach to undermine existing law,” the governor’s spokeswoman said in a statement, according to the Missouri Independent. Missouri voters could have the final say on whether the criminal records of low-level marijuana offenders are cleared when Amendment 3 to legalize recreational marijuana use by adults age 21 and older appears on the Nov. 8 statewide ballot. The measure includes provisions authorizing the automatic expungement of all criminal records for those convicted of non-violent marijuana offenses, excluding driving while under the influence and underage possession. | | | What's on the November 2022 General Election ballot? | | | VOTERS TO DECIDE IF TIME IS RIGHT FOR CONSTITUTIONAL REWRITE Missouri voters on Nov. 8 will decide whether to call a special convention to overhaul or replace the 77-year-old state constitution. The question automatically appears on the general election ballot every 20 years and simply asks: “Shall there be a convention to revise and amend the constitution”? Missouri voters strongly rejected calling a convention the last three times the question was on the ballot, most recently in 2002 when just 34.5 percent were in favor. The question also failed in 1962, with 36.3 percent in support, and 1982, when just 30.5 percent of voters were in favor. As is the case this year, there were no organized campaigns for or against in those prior elections. If voters approve the convention question this time, delegate elections would be held early next year. There would be 83 delegates in all, with 68 delegates – 34 Democrats and 34 Republicans – essentially chosen by the local political party committees in each of Missouri’s state Senate districts. The remaining 15 delegates would be elected statewide by voters, creating the possibility – and perhaps probability in the Republican-dominated state – that a single party could sweep those positions and dominate the convention. The convention would operate independently of the Missouri General Assembly and would even have the power to appropriate money to pay for its expenses without legislative approval. Delegates could choose to propose an entirely new constitution or simply offer amendments to the existing one, just as the legislature already regularly does. There is no timetable for how long a convention could last, but no vote could be held on a new constitution or proposed amendments until after the convention adjourned. The convention would set a special election to take place no sooner than 60 days, and not later than six months, after final adjournment. Ratification of a new constitution or individual amendments would require simple majority support. Missouri voters last approved calling a convention in 1942 with 57.9 percent in support following a bipartisan campaign by business, political and academic leaders stressing the need to replace the Reconstruction-era state constitution enacted in 1875. The resulting convention lasted a little over a year and produced Missouri’s current constitution, which took effect shortly after voters ratified it with 62.7 percent support in February 1945. Voters, with 55.4 percent support, also approved calling a constitutional convention in 1920. After proceedings spanning 18 months, that convention failed to agree on full constitutional rewrite and instead referred 21 individual amendments to voters, who ratified just six. Of the four state constitutions Missouri has had since the first was ratified in 1820, the current Constitution has been in use the longest, and voters have amended it 131 times. Another four proposed amendments will appear on this year’s ballot. | | JUDGE DISMISSES CHALLENGE TO PHOTO VOTER ID REQUIREMENT Cole County Judge Jon Beetem on Oct. 12 dismissed a lawsuit challenging Missouri’s new photo voter identification mandate after ruling the plaintiffs lack the legal standing to bring it. Although a direct appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is expected, barring its swift intervention, voters will be required to produce a government-issued photo ID in order to cast a ballot in the Nov. 8 general election. The state Supreme Court has twice struck down previous photo voter ID laws for unconstitutionally interfering with voting rights, but Beetem didn’t reach the merits of the arguments in the current case. Instead, he determined the only two individual voters named as plaintiffs failed to show they are harmed by the law since both have government-issued photo IDs they can use to vote in the upcoming Nov. 8 elections. Beetem also said the main plaintiffs – the Missouri chapters of the League of Women Voters and the NAACP – likewise lack standing since the harm they alleged their members would suffer is too speculative. The Republican-controlled General Assembly enacted the photo ID requirement earlier this year as part of larger legislation, House Bill 1878, aimed at restricting voting access. A second lawsuit, also brought by the League of Women Voters and the NAACP, challenging other aspects of the bill remains pending before Beetem, a Republican. Friend,

With just three weeks left until ballots are officially counted, we wanted to take a moment and update you directly about the status of Marisa’s race.

Here’s where things currently stand: **\- McCarthy’s leadership is being questioned on both sides of the aisle.** Even staunch Republicans doubt his ability to be an effective speaker. Instead of becoming a leader, he’s become a right-wing puppet with political extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene and Jim Jordan pulling the strings.

**\- The “Red Wave” is losing steam.** More and more voters are realizing the terrifying reality of a GOP-dominated Congress, and recent polling suggests the GOP’s chances of taking back the House are narrower than ever.

**\- Voters officially have their ballots,** which means it’s crunch time here at Wood HQ.**** We’re ramping up our outreach efforts to make sure voters know there’s a viable candidate who can DEFEAT Kevin McCarthy and become a true advocate for our communities. body:
Logo

Peter,

I hope you have all have not forgotten what happened with Mayra Flores's upset win in Texas's 34th District this summer. Her win just proved what I have been saying about my race this entire time. Mayra’s district is 84% Hispanic - mine is 85%. Mayra’s district went OVERWHELMINGLY for Hillary Clinton in 2016... as did mine.

Mayra’s district went overwhelmingly for Joe Biden in 2020... just like mine. After eighteen months of an open border, ridiculously high gas prices, and the general destruction of our American way of life Mayra just OVERWHELMINGLY WON THE DISTRICT!

So many people been telling me it is impossible to win a Hispanic district in South Texas — but they have now been proven wrong. What you need to win is a strong, steadfast candidate who can relate to the voters in Spanish and English - just like Mayra did in her district, I will do that in my district. And we’re winning in nearly every metric that matters.

Do I need to remind you that Joe Biden’s Hispanic approval rating is a mere 24% and dropping every single day? We have a window of opportunity to flip Hispanic districts like we have never seen in our lifetimes... especially after the Dobbs ruling. There is no group more pro-life in this nation than Hispanics!
HELP THE GOP WIN THE HISPANIC VOTE! (https://secure.winred.com/irene-armendariz-jackson-for-congress/donate-copy-d24359ed2cea3b72)

I’m Irene, a wife to a Border Patrol Agent and Veteran, a mother to 3 beautiful daughters, a grandmother to 4 precious grandchildren, a small business owner, and a first-generation American to Mexican immigrants; naturalized citizens, and a firm believer in the American dream.

I grew up in El Paso and am proud to call this incredible community home. Now, I need your help to reclaim this great place that I call home. I’m up against a Democrat candidate that has become lost to the radical Left. She votes with AOC almost 100% of the time and makes Pelosi’s positions look fairly moderate. Her name is Veronica Escobar - and the only reason she’s not part of the Squad is because the Squad doesn’t want her in their club. But she votes with them every single chance she gets.

I want to ensure that we have the chance to flip this district just like Mayra flipped hers. We have the chance to get all five seats that we need to take back the House right here in Southern Texas. I’m going to need to start building a serious war chest to win this race —we’ve been doing well on fundraising but we need to do much better to guarantee victory. The Democrats are going to pour everything they have into this district because they know how close I am to flipping it. What happened in Mayra’s race is going to make them even more worried. It’s going to cause them to spend an even more obscene amount of resources on defeating me.

I’m coming to you because I truly need your most generous donation today -- in the next 24 hours so that we can prove our viability and show the country that THIS is the next major upset district! We need people on board in the next 22 days so we can WIN!

If you can chip $100 in, that's great! If it's $25 that's great, too. Every single dollar counts in this fight and time is nearly out. (https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-V3ghwdNash7sSbQ5KNtfIMN8_BHc1Ji1I4reYMd_rf_m1ZefLTbwQ_kHl5g4KkQQLbN8U5ODt2300kJgtgi_O_q-c0gOeqA_3RZmWyvZUd-C0-zI6efK-4hpEC2hfmMqjPGC5P_T2fXVkL9MrWbQQam8piLMHZQvTsi0VaxGViDdlgVIx6aUlGufW64oJGVClL8mIOz1-lEQdDsQt-C1bhhUrNXHmUuhtu_Wn3z4HU=&c=dju4vWx3GwB9AF-w4FX9oOGSlAg-gu-GbAxMyatcxCrmtC1pObSfew==&ch=zKZseWTwTq8YlLdUNW62spq-0CxZxNEGQTzHPZsd-JAo4zkKlXvVxA==)

If you could dig a little deeper and send $500, $1,000 or even the $2,900 FEC maximum,it will make a big difference now that we are so close to the end. (https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-V3ghwdNash7sSbQ5KNtfIMN8_BHc1Ji1I4reYMd_rf_m1ZefLTbwQ_kHl5g4KkQQLbN8U5ODt2300kJgtgi_O_q-c0gOeqA_3RZmWyvZUd-C0-zI6efK-4hpEC2hfmMqjPGC5P_T2fXVkL9MrWbQQam8piLMHZQvTsi0VaxGViDdlgVIx6aUlGufW64oJGVClL8mIOz1-lEQdDsQt-C1bhhUrNXHmUuhtu_Wn3z4HU=&c=dju4vWx3GwB9AF-w4FX9oOGSlAg-gu-GbAxMyatcxCrmtC1pObSfew==&ch=zKZseWTwTq8YlLdUNW62spq-0CxZxNEGQTzHPZsd-JAo4zkKlXvVxA==) Our deadline is on June 30 and I truly need all the help I can get!

I'm pro-border security, pro-Second Amendment, pro-life. I'm anti-grooming, anti-Biden and I am NOT afraid to speak my mind. I AM THE BORDER CANDIDATE! THIS IS THE BORDER ELECTION!

| | Friend,**

** We recently emailed you to let you know about Derek Schmidt’s [plan for his first 100 days as your next governor.](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=0e63baa3ece849f28012130ceeb6743d&_e=GemOvKUIJMd8cEn8IVCuPzwClH1ga4OyLdYXvgvsh76Z2ZIjfBuO4s5bl7NRkDPLjZWimOBaYaJoUHnKkXOrke3sSaCIvTGhY70YLzFp9k7q0hTvZ1_cFvfmMEm64FX9MFANfALl2MjJlpS619le8lSiL49Bgyuv06QzK-aWok-SjKK3d9xk_rdtCG3vevdy7Q77zzjGwmMiStCElkMYrYyj4gZLJKeUWPgYoF6S8lw%3D) One of his top priorities is putting parents and kids first in Kansas. It’s time for politics to stay out of Kansas schools and for us to support public education. Derek believes in constitutionally-funded public schools and in transparency with Kansas parents about what their children are learning. **This is Derek’s plan for putting kids and parents first:****
**
✔️Constitutionally fund public schools and work with local and state education leaders in their respective roles to reduce our record-setting teacher shortage by supporting, attracting, and retaining great teachers for our kids. ✔️Empower parents to ensure each child gets the education best suited for his or her own needs, regardless of a family’s income or zip code. Protect young children from being exposed to age-inappropriate gender or sexual identity content, discussions, or curriculums in the classroom. ✔️Enact the Fairness in Women’s Sports Act so biological males cannot compete against and take opportunities from our girls in sports. ✔️Protect our kids at school with Derek’s safety school plan, including doubling School Safety Grants, supporting more School Resource Officers, expanding Mental Health Intervention Teams to help and support more struggling kids in more communities, and enacting the Reduce Armed Violence Act to get repeat felons who illegally use firearms to commit new, violent crimes off our streets. Also, provide every child in every school with communication tools for suicide prevention to easily reach out for help. In recent debates, Derek Schmidt outlined these points and called out Laura Kelly for continually lying to the people of Kansas about her stance on key issues like the Fairness in Women’s Sports Act. Kansas deserves better. name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: TOMORROW, TUESDAY – Speaker Pelosi’s Special Elections Messaging Update with Rep. Ted Lieu: Our Lives & Livelihoods Are On The Ballot, on October 18th at 4pm ET / 1pm PT.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

I won’t sugarcoat it: our lives and livelihoods are on the ballot.

In just under 3 weeks, the American people will make a decision between Democrats who put people over politics, creating 10 million new jobs, lowering Rx drug, health care and energy costs, and promoting paid leave and women’s right to choose — and Republicans who refused to help us rebuild our economy and now plan to slash Social Security and Medicare, raise taxes on working families, increase Rx drug prices, and end women's reproductive freedoms.

But we don’t agonize, we organize. Join me and my outstanding colleague, California Congressman Ted Lieu, for a Special Elections Messaging Update tomorrow: Our Lives & Livelihoods Are On The Ballot, on Tuesday, October 18th at 4pm ET / 1pm PT.

Register here:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_zwX3f7jgQHOVjFVTHdxevA

Congressman Lieu, who serves on the Judiciary and Foreign Affairs Committees, is a former active-duty officer in the U.S. Air Force and a prosecutor in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps. In the House, he continues to defend our Constitution and our nation – most prominently as an Impeachment Manager in 2021, after the attack on our Capitol and Democracy on January 6th.As a Co-Chair of the House Democratic Policy and Communications Committee (DPCC) he works to develop House Democrats’ message on our values. Having come to Congress in 2015 after a highly competitive race, Rep. Lieu has gone on to win by huge margins since by winning the trust of his constituents as a fighter for our freedoms and Democracy and a leader on the environment, cybersecurity, civil liberties, and veterans’ issues.

We’ll discuss our winning message tomorrow. Please RSVP:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_zwX3f7jgQHOVjFVTHdxevA

Once again, thank you for all you VIPs – our Volunteers In Politics – do for our country.

Thank you,

NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

It’s truly frightening what Democrats will say or do to win.

They’re not above lying. They are not above taking things conservatives say out of context.**Democrats are not above making up facts that fit into their narrative.** Democrats have not and will not play fairly, and it’s the job of Republicans in Congress to call them out when they abuse the power entrusted to them by the voters (their employers) who sent them to D.C. to represent their interests.

* Democrats don’t want to talk about inflation.
* Democrats don’t want to talk about funding for 87,000 new IRS agents
* Democrats don’t want to talk about Hunter Biden
* Democrats don’t want to talk about the booming economy under President Trump

So, when recently I appeared at the CPAC conference and indicated the importance of investigating the **Biden family’s business dealings** – the activities of Hunter Biden –Democrats pounced, framing unrelated remarks I made about President Trump in a way that could lead some to believe I want to rig the next presidential election.

**Ignoring and redirecting is what Democrats do best** , Fellow American. Democrats want the American public to believe the only reason we want to hold this administration accountable is to tank President Biden’s reelection – but I’ve got news for them: **he’s doing a great job of doing that himself**.

Fellow American, without the adequate resources to punch back against the fake news media and the lies Democrats in Congress would have the American public believe, Republicans may not win in November. [**HELP US STOP DEMOCRAT LIES**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f30fe035873e40f78a935554c7e30363&_e=JpRoCknFE0CRphUxHxe0uinO42u7jUSLInT2lOvQyft9VyNtB7OLMCcQiTrATpXOMve8bKAViq1Jd1iUfKJzS9bbUrzGYA5tKH_s8voMGrQe7i74GKEALs660rqCUDD_nUm12XjE4F6WhuZZxIaGuLMs7GybNGDeceoiKSY4q78Ny4XVq3scwDReT1hLmf-4TDxb4zPyusjIE1D5BXQIJtemi7d6eGU1jKAULRzviIfwM_iBFqv_0Gv6LQTlSAazK5tw-Be0OvwAPc47u6l0nnLC2LDnsAHbt8rPv91hBELDOmXeyhE2kh5YE0pBwJEV)

Please, don’t let them win. **[I need you to stand with us today before it’s too late.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f30fe035873e40f78a935554c7e30363&_e=JpRoCknFE0CRphUxHxe0uinO42u7jUSLInT2lOvQyft9VyNtB7OLMCcQiTrATpXOMve8bKAViq1Jd1iUfKJzS9bbUrzGYA5tKH_s8voMGrQe7i74GKEALs660rqCUDD_nUm12XjE4F6WhuZZxIaGuLMs7GybNGDeceoiKSY4q78gym30TEQxNkjOZQ2EoEJU45noh3ueLDuVMU-rCSplobralmMT2iWsh6ZIq65xxsQibSwMHNFJwc5ToIBnR9ri9lEHdOS2MW96yI_6OVWyycWUgi-vSZMam_he2ygS231HbOJUArhMbUm69DXP9Lr9)**

**Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility, authoring the “Cut, Cap and Balance” plan get the country’s finances back on track. As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

Peter -

[ ]POWER OUR GOTV MACHINE ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison is one of our strongest progressive fighters in the country — and he’s in a tough fight for re-election. The race is a dead heat as his far-right extremist opponent takes big money to slander him with an onslaught of ads. But, Keith is ‘The People’s Lawyer’ and we have people-power on our side to reach voters directly with the facts. AG Ellison has had a career of public service — in the State Legislature and the U.S. Congress. His opponent is a hedge fund lawyer who wants to criminalize abortion at 6 weeks, defund corporate law enforcement, and gut consumer protections. As AG, Keith Ellison put hundreds of thousands of dollars back into the pockets of Minnesota workers who were victims of wage theft. And, he’s holding Big Pharma accountable for the damage of the opioid epidemic — winning hundreds of millions for Minnesota. When a hedge fund landlord stopped repairing their properties, leaving families without heat and subject to mold and lead paint, Keith stepped in to defend Minnesotans. When we say Keith Ellison is the people’s lawyer, that’s what we mean. That’s the work Jim Schultz wants to defund. [ ][IMG] Last week, Bernie joined US Reps. Ilhan Omar and Pramila Jayapal to travel across Minnesota and [ ]rally support for Keith — and Our Revolution is going all-out to turnout our 147,000 supporters in the state. Our Phone Bank Force has already made 42,000 phone calls in Minnesota, and we’re launching 100,000 texts and postcards to 65,000 households of Our Revolution members with a simple message: The choice is clear. While Keith is taking on corporate criminals who are price-gouging customers and stealing worker wages, his opponent wants to [ ]defund corporate law enforcement altogether and take away women’s reproductive rights. [ ][IMG] Doing the people’s work earns you powerful enemies, and Keith is in a fight to the finish. Can you step up to help re-elect Keith Ellison? [ ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution proudly supports Oscar De Los Santos for the AZ House of Representatives in District 11. Born to working-class immigrant parents, Oscar has dedicated his life and career to public service and progressive values. He knows healthcare is a human right and that everyone deserves a living wage. As a teacher at a low-income school in South Phoenix, he’s been at the frontlines of the fight for better-funded schools and better teacher pay. Oscar has fought for economic justice — and won. He led the passage of a bill that doubled the cash assistance program for low-income families and spearheaded a coalition restoring food assistance for those with felonies. Oscar currently works combatting Republican attacks on our democracy, and now we can help put him in the State House! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Also in Arizona, we must re-elect Sandra Kennedy and add Lauren Kuby to the little-known but powerful Corporation Commission. Sandra was elected in 2018 after the electric utility APS spent more than $10M to defeat her in 2014 and elect commissioners who voted to raise utility prices, [ ]Marketplace reports. This is why Our Revolution is going all out in this key down-ballot race — utility corporations can’t be allowed to choose their own regulators and we need climate champions like Kennedy and Kuby in these key down-ballot seats. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] PHONEBANK SPOTLIGHT “Wow, I just had my best call of the week!” Our Revolution phone banker Amanda Walker told us on Monday after a great conversation with an Arizona voter about “the energy bigwigs having their fingers in the pie.” “I’m so glad we're calling on this race,” Amanda said. “I love that the [ ]Phonebank Force is involved in down-ballot calling like this that has such concrete implications!” You can join Amanda by making calls to elect progressives up and down the ballot — from Arizona to Pennsylvania and everywhere in between! All told, our call team has made more than 857,000 calls and counting! [ ]JOIN OUR CALL TEAM ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution is working hard to make sure Megan Green becomes the next president of the St. Louis Board of Alderman — especially as her opponent Jack Coatar rakes in cash from anti-union and big developer sources. Megan supports hotel workers trying to organize with Unite Here Local 74, [ ]STL Today reports, while Coatar sides with the bosses who are also his donors. “He’s the big-money candidate in the race to replace Reed, who was the big-money candidate before Coatar,” [ ]STL Today writes. “Reed, of course, is headed to a likely federal prison sentence for taking bribes in development deals.” In her time on the board, Megan helped pass a $15 minimum wage bill in the city while Coatar voted against it. As board president, she would strengthen the growing bloc of progressive power in the city that includes the Mayor. That’s why Our Revolution callers have dialed out to more than 25,000 voters in the city and we want to triple that before Election Day. [ ]Sign-up to volunteer today! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Progressives like Rep. Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib asked Our Revolution members to help send reinforcements to grow progressive power in the House — and that’s exactly what we’re doing! The Washington Post says our movement is on track to dramatically expand the ranks of progressives in the House with Our Revolution-endorsed candidates like Greg Casar, Maxwell Frost, Summer Lee, and other primary winners likely to win in the general election. We’re not just playing it safe — our volunteers are working to win priority competitive races for progressives including Jamie McLeod-Skinner in Oregon’s 5th District and Michelle Vallejo in Texas’ 15th! [ ]DONATE TO PUT PROGRESSIVES IN THE HOUSE! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ OUR FREEDOMS, OUR VOTE! [ ][IMG] US Senate candidate Mandela Barnes rallied with us Thursday in Milwaukee, WI as we kicked off a nationwide week of action. Thursday’s January 6th hearing revealed more shocking details of the crimes against our democracy, and we’re ratcheting up the pressure for justice. That’s why Our Revolution, Public Citizen, and our coalition will hold more than 70 events for #OurFreedomsOurVote this week with calls to action from civil rights and union leaders, election officials and poll workers, state lawmakers and members of Congress,” [ ]Common Dreams reports. Martin Luther King III, Arndrea Waters King, and US Rep. Raul Grijalva will be joining some of the more than 70 events planned across the country — and you’re invited! [ ][IMG] “The hearings are important, but Congress only has the power to investigate, not to prosecute,” OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese said. “That power falls to us, we have the power to hold the insurrectionists accountable.” RSVP TO JOIN AN EVENT NEAR YOU! Oct. 19 - [ ]Harrisburg, PA Oct. 20 - [ ]Wash, D.C. | [ ]Philly, PA | [ ]Phoenix, AZ Oct. 21 - [ ]Manhattan, NYC Oct. 22 - [ ]Dayton, OH * Oct. 23 - [ ]Cincinnati, OH Find more event locations here, or sign up to host one of your own. Our coalition team is on hand to support you every step of the way. [ ]OurFreedomsOurVote.com ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] RALLY WITH AMAZON WORKERS! Our Revolution: NY Progressive Action Network rallied with Amazon workers this week in Albany as voting runs through Monday to unionize at the #ALB1 location. There were [ ]FIRES in the warehouse last week, and we’re sounding the alarm to stand with workers who are organizing a union to improve health and safety in their workplaces. Also, ONT8 in Moreno Valley, CA filed for their election this week with Amazon Labor. This is about solidarity and showing up, the grassroots doing the groundwork — let's go! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution and our coalition fighting Big Tech notched a win this week with the passage of a House bill to give enforcers more resources to go after anti-competitive mergers and give state AGs more power over which courts they bring antitrust lawsuits in. “This shows there is still a chance for two other key bills to pass later this year,” [ ]CNBC reported on our big push to Bust Big Tech. Let’s keep up the pressure and the momentum! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] [ ]LA Progressive reported this week on the work of Our Revolution and our coalition of climate allies resulting in our Phase 1 victory over Joe Manchin and his Dirty Deal. We were among the first to organize to stop the deal, marshaling our resources and mobilizing thousands of calls to House and Senate offices. Our activists bird-dogged legislators at their offices, rallied on Capitol Hill, pushed the CPC, and ultimately tipped the balance. We know it’s not over, but we’ll be ready when the dirty deal rears its ugly head again. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution: NY Progressive Action Network will hold its first in-person fundraiser party in three years! Come and celebrate progressive champions like Eddie Kaye, Sochie Nnaemeka, Gustavo Rivera, and many more! The party will go from noon to 2 pm Sunday at Turkuaz at 310 West 53rd St., Manhattan. There is both inside and outside space for comfort and finger foods and a cash bar to enjoy! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Progressive Mandela Barnes can take out far-right Senator Ron Johnson in Wisconsin — with our help! He’s in a tough race, but we have a path to victory and can flip this key seat. [ ]MAKE CALLS FOR MANDELA ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Dr. Oz is closing the gap and we can’t let him win! We need YOU to make calls for John Fetterman! Let’s make sure we flip this senate seat, defeat Dr. Oz, and elect a progressive! [ ]CALL FOR FETTERMAN ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] We have to marshal our resources NOW to execute our strategy over the next three weeks to defeat the far right and elect progressives on Nov. 8th. If we connect with each voter 4 times — by phone, text, mail, social media, and door-knocking — we can boost turnout by 11 percent and make a decisive difference in tight races. [ ]Donate now to power our Swing State strategy! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Early voting has started and we have a tough fight on our hands to re-elect Keith Ellison as Attorney General! We need to help Keith defeat a far-right extremist! Keith has taken on corporate price-gouging in the pandemic and led the fight to convict Derek Chauvin for the Murder of George Floyd. [ ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Megan Green — a 2016 Bernie delegate we helped elect to the St. Louis Board of Alderman last cycle — is up against union busters and big developer money in her run for board president. This is a key seat for a progressive and we can win! [ ]CALL FOR MEGAN IN ST. LOUIS ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] This primary season, Our Revolution Phonebank Force has made more than 857,000 calls to voters across the country. Sign up to activate voters for progressive candidates across the country. [ ]SIGN UP FOR A CALL SHIFT ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Become a sustaining member of Our Revolution for just $5/mo. and get your official membership card. For $10, get our collectible sticker 6-pack — $15, get the stickers + a poster — $27, get both + a tote bag — $50, get it ALL + a T-shirt! [ ]BECOME A MOVEMENT BUILDER ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ]Facebook | [ ]Twitter | [ ]Instagram | [ ]Youtube | [ ]Website | [ ]Sign Up [ ]Our membership swag Our Revolution is the largest entirely grassroots funded progressive group in America. Last year alone, we elected 74% of our 450 endorsed progressive candidates by mobilizing on the ground AND in the halls of power. Democracy in action is a powerful thing.

Earlier today — the first day of early voting in Georgia — I made sure to cast my ballot. And I was so encouraged by the enthusiasm and engagement I saw among others around me. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52804800/373436012/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221017EV2_N_JJ_FULL_6_G_N_P1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5M2Q0YzVjNy03MjRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lpZsw2qR1CVFajw4W2hmrjdTi9VPGLbljeC50OiFMos=) There's no question in my mind that interest in Georgia's election is high, up and down the ballot. Folks realize just how important offices like Attorney General are for so many aspects of their lives — from healthcare access, to consumer protection, to having clean and breathable air.

Georgians are making their final decisions in this race now, and we need to maintain our resources to get our message in front of them. With the stakes this high, it's no surprise that Republican special interests are spending millions to defeat me — but their lies could prevail if we fall behind in our fundraising goals.

[**This is when grassroots support matters the most. If you can, please donate so we can reach our goal of 250 donations by midnight →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52804801/373436013/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221017EV2_N_JJ_FULL_6_G_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5M2Q0YzVjNy03MjRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lpZsw2qR1CVFajw4W2hmrjdTi9VPGLbljeC50OiFMos=)

Thank you!

Jen

P.S. I received so many well-wishes from loved ones, friends, and supporters for my birthday. It truly means a lot, and I couldn't have asked for a better way to spend my birthday than by making my voice heard in this landmark election. | | | **Democratic State Senator Jen Jordan (pronounced Jer-Dun) has spent her legal career fighting for Georgians. Because of her real-life experience in the courtroom and out of it, Jen knows that now, more than ever, we need an Attorney General who will take a stand and fight for the rights of each and every Georgian.** ****[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52804802/373436014/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221017EV2_N_JJ_FULL_6_G_N_BioBox&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5M2Q0YzVjNy03MjRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lpZsw2qR1CVFajw4W2hmrjdTi9VPGLbljeC50OiFMos=)****

name: Team Slotkin
subject: Looking back at ‘22 with 22 days left
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28]
Team,
It’s been quite a year, and we’re nearly to Election Day – 22 days to be specific. So, since there are just 22 days until the 2022 midterms, we thought we’d send a recap of this truly packed year.
New District:
Let’s start at the beginning: we found out what the new 7th district would look like in December 2021. With the addition of 3 new counties, 28,382 more people, and 1,310 more square miles, we knew we had our work cut out for us. Thirty-five percent of the 7th district is new to Elissa. That’s why she immediately hit the ground with one important question in mind for the folks of the new 7th: what do you *actually* want to see from your representative?
Snow Boots on the Ground:
That question was at the forefront of our minds as we kicked off Snow Boots on the Ground -- our first tour around the new district. It was an appropriate name for a tour of mid-Michigan in the middle of February! This was Elissa’s first big chance to knock on some doors, meet a ton of local leaders, visit some small businesses, and begin building out the volunteer networks that we would rely on later.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28]
Petitions:
Our next big milestone was turning in 2,000 signatures – the maximum number possible – to officially get Elissa’s name on the ballot. Three hundred dedicated volunteers spent nights and weekends at events and popular community gathering spaces to collect a total of 5,000 signatures from all 7 counties in the new district. These folks are the backbone of our campaign, so it was only fitting that we throw a party to celebrate in April, right after Elissa turned in the petitions.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28]
Gazebos and Festivals:
Then, it was on to the summer. People were out and about in the new district and we were determined to meet as many of them as possible. Mid-Michigan loves a unique summer festival and we had a presence at as many as we possibly could. We brought back a 2020 Team Slotkin favorite – the Gazebo Tour. Elissa had the chance to talk to big crowds about lowering the cost of prescription drugs, bringing manufacturing back to America, and ensuring a brighter future for our kids.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28]
TV and Digital Ads:
Another highlight of summer? Launching our TV and digital ads. Our first TV ad launched on 4th of July weekend, and we’ve released 7 more since – you can check them all out here [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] . These ads have been an especially critical part of running in a brand new district. As hard as Elissa tries, she can’t meet every single person in the new 7th. And, because this is the most expensive House race in the entire country, a lot of folks have been bombarded with negative ads about her. Our ads have been a crucial part of introducing Elissa and setting the record straight.
MSU Campus Plan:
A significant part of our strategy has been trying to talk to as many MSU students as we possibly can, and registering them to vote in East Lansing. Peer-to-peer outreach has been the name of the game here. We've been hosting “dorm storms” – events where our part-time student organizers distribute registration information to the students that live in their *actual* dorm. Since we’re always hiring new student organizers, if you know an MSU student that may want to join Team Slotkin, send them to https://forms.gle/2n5FEVXDUg6Q6mLC9. We have flexible, paid opportunities for them to register their fellow students on campus, spread critical information about voting, work directly with campaign staff, and get some real-life campaign experience.
Non-stop Voter Outreach:
Now, we’re in the final stretch. Our field team has been working non-stop to reach voters in the new 7th. Distributing yard signs, knocking on doors, making phone calls, training up student organizers on MSU’s campus – anything to ensure mid-Michigan voters have a plan to make their voices heard.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221017_2&amount=28]
It’s definitely been a crazy year, and we want to thank you for being along for the ride with us. It’s because of people like you that we’ve been able to host events, hire staff, run ads on TV, and everything else that goes into running a strategic campaign. We still have a bit more up our sleeves, so with just 22 days to go, will you chip in $22 to help us reach the finish line? name: Josh Riley
subject: If you read one more email tonight, I hope it’s this one
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Josh Riley for Congress
body:
Republican Super PACs just dumped nearly $4 million in attack ads against me this month, and it’s not yet certain we’ll have the resources to fight back.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52805077/373436863/-209395415?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20221017-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNmY0ZDgwMS03NDRlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gsge-jW85PTKUdAzi4Oi1eyBav6-Cp4-Ty2aeEzD5hQ=)

| Peter,

Nearly a year ago, I announced I was running for Congress to fight for places like my hometown in Broome County.

**11 months later, two rounds of redistricting, 20 counties, and several GOP opponents later, only 22 days now separate us and Election Day in one of the tightest House races across the country. The polls have this race within the margin of error.**

Peter, there are a lot of positive updates to share - huge momentum on the ground, and support building across the Southern Tier, Catskills, and Upper Hudson Valley.

But, there’s one gravely concerning update I have to share with you, too. Republican Super PACs just dumped nearly $4 million in attack ads against me this month, and it’s not yet certain we’ll have the resources to fight back.

body:
John made me realize I knew NOTHING.
#
Hey Derek, it’s John Hodgman — writer, comedian, actor, and the Daily Show’s “Resident Expert.”
Let me share a story with you real quick about why I support John Fetterman and you should, too. But first — **[can you join me in supporting the campaign by chipping in a $5 donation today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221017-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221017-7773&refcode2=7773_434096_j-T-mU&akid=7773%2E434096%2Ej-T-mU)**
**[Chip In Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221017-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221017-7773&refcode2=7773_434096_j-T-mU&akid=7773%2E434096%2Ej-T-mU)**
Okay, back to my story. It’s fall 2020. I’m cynical about the presidential election and am trying to emotionally prepare for Pennsylvania to stick with Trump for another four years. I’m listening to Pod Save America and the hosts tease an interview with Lt. Governor of Pennsylvania John Fetterman about how Biden will perform in PA. _Not interested._
But I ended up listening anyway, and that’s when I realized I was Jon Snow: I knew NOTHING.
John broke down the PA county-by-county electoral map so confidently and cogently I felt I could see it floating in front of me. It showed such deeeeep knowledge of the place he lives and works — and who he wants to represent in the U.S. Senate — and an incredible facility for making data sing out its importance.
When he said “watch Erie County,” I believed him. When he said he thought it would be close but that Biden would win PA, I WORKED VERY HARD to shut down my cynicism and accept his actual expertise and believe him.
That's when I knew: **this guy has got the GOODS.**
I felt like an idiot for not knowing about him before, and an extra idiot for picturing him as some data dweeb like me instead of a big dude in shorts. WHO LIVES IN A CONVERTED CAR DEALERSHIP.
So yeah, I was late to the party by learning about John just two years ago, but let me be so clear: I AM INTO THIS GUY.
Someone who combines that level of deep knowledge, communication skills, an obvious sincere devotion to public service (check his Wikipedia) with that kind of absolute confidence in who he is?
**I’m excited to be on his side — and I hope you are too, Derek.****[Will you join me in supporting John Fetterman by chipping in $5 or more today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221017-3?amount=5&refcode=em20221017-7773&refcode2=7773_434096_j-T-mU&akid=7773%2E434096%2Ej-T-mU)**

| | | | | _Cliff here, _Peter _. We know you’re getting a lot of campaign messages right now, because we’re getting them too. It’s something else! But I think you know, like we know, how much is riding on this election if we want candidates who support working families.

Take this Utah Senate race. It’s the first real chance Democrats have had in 50 years to have a Senator from Utah we could support. It puts a lot of pressure on Republicans to have to defend a Senate seat in a state that’s usually safe for them and that we could really win. Do we want wealthy conservatives to just walk away with this Senate race, and walk away with the Senate, like they have so many times before?_ _It’s down to what we want to see happen this November. Which campaign will have the resources to get more of their supporters to the polls? How do we want to feel when the votes come in on Election Night? Will we know we did all we could to make the outcome better for all Americans? It’s up to us, right now._ _And so I’ll leave the rest to the brave, the compassionate, Dr. Mary Trump ..._ [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcddb9303-4cd2-4783-87dd-9da27f4ee42c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Peter,_ I’m writing to ask for your support in electing Evan McMullin to represent Utah in the U.S. Senate. But first, let me tell you about his far-right, anti-democracy opponent Mike Lee and why we must replace him this November. Mike Lee is dangerous, Peter. He’s the type of self-serving politician who will do and say anything in order to appease the extremists and special interest groups bankrolling his campaign. Sound familiar? It does to me, too.
